===Levels 30–99: Motherlode Mine===
[[File:Motherlode Mine.png|275x275px|right]]
Mining in the [[Motherlode Mine]] is a profitable low-effort alternative to the faster methods. To do this, mine [[ore vein]]s inside the mine, deposit the [[pay-dirt]] into the [[Hopper (Motherlode Mine)|hopper]] to clean it, and repeat. Once the [[Sack (Motherlode Mine)|sack]] is full, empty it and bank the ores for profit. The veins deplete after 36–40 seconds in the upper level, or 23–27 seconds in the lower level. At higher levels, this method is only recommended for players who are looking for a straightforward training method, as the [[Volcanic Mine]] minigame offers faster experience.

To get there, use a [[skills necklace]] teleport to the [[Mining Guild]] and run a short distance to the entrance. Players will need a pickaxe to clear the obstructing rockfalls to enter deeper into the mine.

Completing the [[Falador Diary#Medium|medium Falador Diary]] grants the player access to a shortcut (requires level 54 Agility) to an area which is near the bank chest and relatively close to the hopper. Completion of the [[Falador Diary#Elite|elite diary]] will also increase the chance of receiving higher-level ores.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/928241637880467456|date=8 November 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/107851|archivedate=30 May 2020|quote=[Was the diary reward for ore-choosing fixed?] 18th June 2015, yes.}}

Players can obtain [[golden nugget]]s through cleaning [[pay-dirt]], which can be used to purchase perks and rewards from [[Prospector Percy]]. The most notable reward is the [[Prospector kit]], which adds a bonus 2.5% experience while mining. Purchasing the prospector helmet is required for the hard Falador Diary. Unlock the upper levels of the mine as soon as it becomes available. 

Experience rates vary depending on the Mining level and what upgrades have been unlocked. At level 90 with a dragon pickaxe and a celestial ring, prospector kit, with the upgraded sack, the upper level unlocked and the upper chute unlocked, players can gain around 62,000 experience per hour.

For more up to date calculations on profit per hour, see [[Money making guide/Motherlode Mine|Motherlode Mine]].
